item.title: Whining Irish: Notre Dame fans vent about missing CFP, Alabama getting in — ‘This playoff is a farce’
item.description: Notre Dame fans complained on Sunday about not being included in the College Football Playoffs.After a strong finish to the season for Notre Dame, coupled with Alabama getting trounced by Georgia in the SEC Championship game on Saturday, the Fighting Irish faithful were shocked to find out on Sunday that the selection committee picked Miami and Alabama over Notre Dame.In response, Notre Dame opted out of consideration for a bowl game. pic.twitter.com/TyzavvzpC1— Notre Dame Football (@NDFootball)

item.title: UA mag editor on shuttered identity-based magazines: 'It is honestly offensive to be told that my magazine isn't for everyone'
item.description: Gabrielle Gunter, the now-former editor of Alice Magazine, the University of Alabama publication for women, continued her tour to feed the leftwing outrage machine this weekend. On Sunday, Gunter appeared on MSNow’s "Politics Nation" with Al Sharpton to express her criticism of the university’s indefinite suspension of Alice and Nineteen Fifty-Six, the university’s black magazine.
